# What crates/cli/tests/e2e.rs expects for this scenario. ok/fail: does
# the job run when every job before it passed, or failed. A step `if`
# shows A/B: runs while the job passes / runs after an earlier step failed.

convert: exit 0
  `ci.yml` job `lint` calls `acme/shared-workflows/.github/workflows/lint.yml@v3`, a reusable workflow in another repository, which is not supported; copy `lint.yml` into this repository and call it as `./.github/workflows/lint.yml`; the job was dropped
validate: exit 0
event push-main (compile refs/heads/main)
  ci: triggered
    job ci-build-build on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm run build -- --target web
    job test on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      step actions/checkout@v5
      step run: npm ci && npm test
    job deploy-preview on ubuntu-latest after ci-build-build + test: ok=skip fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      step deploy
    job e2e on ubuntu-latest after deploy-preview: ok=skip fail=skip
      step run: npx playwright test
